title: Chat bubble: chat-start and chat-end (daisyUI)
notes:
Chat bubbles are used to show one line of conversation and all its data, including the author image, author name, time, etc.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/chat/+page.md
